title: Weak Verlinde Formula beyond Rational Conformal Field Theory
exact_target: Beyond rational conformal theory, do asymptotic quantum dimensions still multiply according to fusion?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002841 (OWR-13673-011). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Conformal Field Theory (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/16, pp. 849--926. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 53, 54.
Huang, Verlinde conjecture (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Creutzig--Milas--Wood, regularized dimensions (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: Existence and normalization of the character limits and the chosen fusion ring are part of the problem. Logarithmic and nonrational theories must not be replaced by the rational case in a proposed answer.
